name: nginx-multisite
description: Nginx multi-site web server with SSL termination, security hardening, and firewall configuration. Orchestrates sub-recipes for fail2ban/UFW setup, nginx installation and templating, self-signed certificate generation, and per-vhost site configuration.

name: cache
description: Caching layer that installs and configures both Memcached and Redis on the same host, including Redis password authentication and a ruby_block workaround to strip deprecated directives from the generated Redis config file.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Full-stack Python application deployment that clones a FastAPI app from GitHub, sets up a Python virtual environment, provisions a PostgreSQL database, writes a .env file with credentials, and registers a systemd service to run the app via uvicorn.
